title: Hosted API region pin CLI and webhook audit stream
creator: Priya Nair
description: Enable operators and compliance teams to programmatically assert, change, and audit region-pinning decisions for Hosted API endpoints via a lightweight CLI and a dedicated webhook-based audit stream. This ticket covers product requirements, API contract, rollout guardrails, and automated evidence packaging for compliance reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: A CLI (redwoodctl residency pin) allows operators to set/unset region pins for a tenant endpoint and returns an immutable operation id
A webhook audit stream emits every pin operation as a signed event (JSON) with before/after state, operator identity, timestamp, and evidence bundle pointer
The Console reflects CLI-originated changes in under 10s and surfaces the operation id with a link to the evidence bundle
Evidence bundles are automatically generated and stored in the compliance bucket with retention metadata and an exportable zip via the Console
Automated tests (unit + e2e) validate signature verification on the webhook consumer and detect missing retention tags
notes: Motivation: Compliance teams asked for a machine-friendly way to ingest residency decision events into third-party SIEMs and GRC workflows.
Scope: Hosted endpoints only (no Dedicated/Private) for MVP. CLI will be a thin wrapper around the control-plane API.
Trade-offs: Keeping CLI thin reduces maintenance but requires strict API backward-compatibility. Signed webhook events increase complexity but are necessary for non-repudiation.
Privacy: Audit events should not contain customer prompt/response payloads; only metadata and evidence pointers are allowed. Evidence bundles must be redaction-ready.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal Canary (security + compliance teams) with feature-flagged CLI and webhook consumer. Phase 2: Gradual opt-in for customers via Console toggle + API key scoping. Phase 3: GA and add retention policy templates for common jurisdictions.
risks: If evidence bundle generation fails, operators may perform manual exports — need runbook and fallbacks
Signed webhook key rotation must be coordinated across consumers to avoid missed events
Race conditions between CLI and Console views if caching is not invalidated
